isPrivateContext.description: Propagated so the store write path can honour §20.8.

gateOrdinal.description:
1-based index of the Tier 2 gate event within the session; dense and monotonic (Rule Engine §2.4). Null for Tier 0 and Tier 1 invocations, which are not gates.

ADDED at contract v1.1.0. Backend §12.3 makes gate submission idempotent on `(sessionId, gateOrdinal)`, so the value must cross the Role A → Role B boundary and, in the HTTP projection, the client-server boundary. It had no canonical definition; this is that definition.

`tier` is NOT part of the HTTP projection of this structure (BI-32, Backend §5.1).
